Entity.name: Balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative asset position national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP)
Entity.commentInRDBMS: Balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative asset position national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) is a Balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative position role to which the nGAAP accounting standard applies.

Attribute.name: Fiduciary asset indicator
Attribute.comment: Identification of instruments in which the observed agent acts in its own name but on behalf of and with the risk borne by a third party.

Attribute.name: Haircuts for trading position valued at fair value
Attribute.comment: Haircut for trading position valued at fair value. According to Annex V (5.29): Where applicable under national GAAP based on BAD, ‘Haircuts for trading positions valued at fair value’ shall be reported. The haircuts decrease the value of trading assets and increase the value of trading liabilities.
